ONE CHAMPION. A SHARED AMBITION.

Give the next generation
a stronger opening.

Ahmed Adly’s own journey inspired a simple ambition: give young players the coaching, structure and support he had worked so hard to find.

Today, that ambition brings students and coaches together around the board, with room to learn, compete and belong.
